_tone: Direct, a bit of grit, warm. Talk like a friend who's doing it with you. Never preachy, never guilt-trippy, no hustle-bro. The flame speaks in first person, short and playful. Always 'your day' / 'your midnight' (clanmates live in other time zones). No emoji in UI strings.

app.name: The 90
app.tagline: Hard days, together. Keep your flame alive with your crew.

auth.noPasswords: No passwords. We send you a link, you tap it, you’re in.
auth.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this phone.
auth.invalidEmail: That doesn’t look like a full email address.
auth.sendError: Couldn’t send the link. Check your connection and try again.
auth.linkExpired: That link expired. Send yourself a fresh one.

setup.nameTitle: What should your clan call you?
setup.nameBody: Clanmates see this next to your flame.
setup.flameBody: It’s yours for the whole challenge. Keep it alive.
setup.noClanBody: Nobody does 90 days alone. Start one or jump into your friends’.
setup.startClanSub: Pick a challenge, invite your people
setup.joinClan: Join with a link or code
setup.joinClanSub: Got an invite? Paste it here

create.title: New clan
create.pickBody: You can edit the tasks next.
create.templateMeta: {days} days · {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
create.minTasks: You need at least one task.
create.tasksNote: 1 to 10 tasks. Everyone in the clan does the same list.
create.leaderboardNote: Only your clan name, challenge and averages. Never member names.
create.litBody: Get your people in. Everyone starts their own Day 1 when you let them in.
create.qrNote: Scan in person, like at a chapter meeting
create.shareText: Join {clan} on The 90. {challenge}, {days} days. Keep your flame alive with us: {url}

join.requestNote: You’re in {n} of 5 clans. The leader approves new members.
join.signedOutNote: Your Day 1 starts the day the leader lets you in.
join.pendingBody: {clan}’s leader has your request. We’ll strike your match the second they let you in.
join.live: Live. This screen updates by itself.
join.approvedBody: Welcome to {clan}. Day 1 starts now and ends at your midnight.
join.errInvalidBody: The link may be mistyped or the clan was deleted. Ask for a fresh one.
join.errFullBody: {max} of {max} spots are taken. The leader can raise the limit, or you can start your own clan.
join.errLimitBody: That’s the max, and pending requests count. Leave a clan or cancel a request to join this one.
join.errRejectedBody: {clan}’s leader didn’t approve your request. No hard feelings: start your own and invite your people.

flame.half: Halfway! Two more before your midnight.
flame.full: Stuffed. Day {day} is in the bag.
flame.anxious: Under 3 hours left and I’m still hungry. One more!
flame.legend: Legend. I burn for good now.

today.completeBody: Fed and full. {left} days to go. {clan} just saw you finish.
today.breakTitle: Did you break a rule today?
today.breakBody: Honesty keeps the clan real. Your flame goes out right now, {clan} will see it, and you start again at Day 1 today.
today.breakStakes: {n} days of this run will end. Your best stays {best}.
today.finishedBody: Your flame burns for good now. {clan} will see it here every day.
today.finishedLocked: Tasks are closed for good. Legends don’t check boxes.
today.whatsNextBody: Start a fresh run or a new clan. Your crown comes with you.

death.title: Your flame went out on Day {day}
death.bodyMidnight: Midnight hit with {n, plural, one {one task} other {# tasks}} left. It happens to everyone once. Legends are the ones who relight.
death.bodyRule: You called it honestly. That counts for something. Legends are the ones who relight.
death.relitTag: Attempt {n} · {scars, plural, one {# scar} other {# scars}}
death.relitBody: A tiny spark again. Your best is {best} days. Go beat it.

clan.clanColorBody: Everyone in {clan} sees this theme. Each person’s flame keeps its own color, and light or dark follows their phone.
clan.leaveBody: Your flame here goes out for good.
clan.leaveBodyLeader: Your flame here goes out for good. You’re the leader, so {next} takes over (they’ve been here longest).
clan.leaveBodyLast: You’re the last one here. Leaving deletes {clan} for good.
clan.rotated: New invite link ready. The old one stopped working.
clan.leaveBodyLeaderAny: Your flame here goes out for good. You’re the leader, so whoever has been here longest takes over.

milestoneSub.21: Three weeks. It’s who they are now.
milestoneSub.30: Horns unlocked. A third of the way.

feed.diedSub: Attempt {attempt} ended at their midnight. Attempt {next} starts today.
feed.finishedSub: Legend status. Their flame burns here for good.

ranks.title: Clan ranks
ranks.subtitle: Ranked by average days alive. Clan names only, never people.
ranks.emptyBody: Clans need 2 or more members to get on the board. Bring one friend and {clan} is in.

me.title: Me
me.unlockHeadbandBody: Your best run hit 7 days. First week, done.
me.unlockHornsBody: Your best run hit 30 days. That’s a tough flame.
me.unlockCrownBody: You finished a challenge. Wear it everywhere.
me.trophiesBody: Milestone badges and finished challenges live here.

push.promptBody: One nudge when your flame is hungry late in your day. Never more than two a day.
push.hungry: Your flame has {hours} hours left, {n, plural, one {1 task} other {# tasks}} to go.
push.lastHour: Last hour. Your flame is running on fumes.

system.offline: You’re offline. Checks save on your phone and sync when you’re back.
system.errorBody: Your flame is fine. We just couldn’t load this screen.
system.emptyFeedBody: Nobody has finished today yet. Be the first.
system.emptyRequestsBody: When someone asks to join, they’ll wait here.
system.emptyMembersBody: Invite a friend. Fires burn better together.

share.deathLine: Best run: {best} days. Coming for it.
